text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Oaks...! I've been looking forward
to it so much that I even dreamed about it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All the other runners felt like the wind, you know?
Every time they passed me, I felt like I was fluttering...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It felt so good, and my speed just kept
climbing higher and higher...! The result was..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it's a secret♪
Look forward to what comes next!

Even in the second race of the Triple Tiara route,
Fine Motion shows no signs of being particularly nervous.
However—

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*.
I really can't do it, I just can't...

Crouched in the corner of the path and crying was an Umamusume who had also run in the Oka Sho.
She had carried immense expectations into the race, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...
Trainer, please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...!
Fine-chan...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's calm down and take a deep breath, okay?
Inhale, exhale~...

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! I'm... just so scared of letting everyone down... again...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You never know the outcome until it begins.
Come on, smile for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's a race, after all.
Let's just have fun with it♪ If we do that, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's the Yushun Himba, you know? It's historic,
it's a GⅠ, and it's a race everyone's looking forward to...

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Have fun...? There's no way I can.
You wouldn't understand, Fine-chan.
Because even if you lose, you have 'other things'..."

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm so sorry!
Just now, I... said something horrible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's right. To be completely honest, I don't really understand feeling anxious.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because every single race feels fresh and new to me,
and it's so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just running makes me so happy
and gets my heart racing... There's nothing to be afraid of.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, even I understand now...
Just how special this race—the Triple Tiara—really is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to run here must feel like a dream.
That's why I want them to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: After all, this is your race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's true that racing
isn't everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yet just for this single moment, I want to make it everything.
...Because all we have is now."

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want every single runner beside me
to be in their absolute best condition.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That she wants to run a magnificent race,
like the wind sweeping past...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I just realized,
that's a pretty arrogant request, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...It's the first time someone's ever told me to 'do my best for their sake'...

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still... is it really okay for me to think
about myself this much?
Is it okay to run just for me...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Because you're the star of the show—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
――Alright, I'm heading out♪
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Go run your own race too.
Now go run as only you can

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'm off!
